about: Declared-part cases shared by the host's test (workflow_declaration.rs) and the web test (requirement-declaration.test.mjs). 'declaration' is the selection row's declaration as the host serializes it for 'text'; 'requirementDeclaration' is the host's one reading of declared against undeclared for the same bytes. The host test recomputes both from 'text' (or 'error') and refuses a difference. Invented content only.
